svg.title: AI Automation for SEO & Content
svg.desc: Seven-stage research funnel workflow for SEO: a target topic arrives via brief form, Gemini and Perplexity sweep search data into the wide funnel mouth, keywords cluster by intent, a structured brief builds into Google Docs, Claude and OpenAI write the draft, internal links weave via site crawl, and a human editor approves for CMS publishing.
svg.text: Topic brief → search sweep → outline → CMS
